# Dog_Cost_Matrix.txt -- the #1533 substitution matrix (E4 attribution)
#
# Generated by DogShowcaseEvidenceTest.CostOfTheThreeFramings, one process per row, with
# OLO_DOG_COST=1 and OLO_DOG_COST_SUB / OLO_DOG_COST_LAWN as named; each run's whole report is below.
# Commit a2fd7467ba (the build id in each report is the binary's).
# GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090/PCIe/SSE2
# Build 0.0.1+a2fd7467ba, driver 4.6.0 NVIDIA 617.14.
# The editor's quality tier: 4096^2 cascades, PCF, AO technique 2, bloom on, FXAA on.
# Release test binary, 1920x1080, GL Forward, the scene's TAA, the live scene's lawn, 240 runtime
# frames per framing after a 90-frame warm-up; baselines at the start, middle and end.
#
# READ IT THIS WAY. A substitution is a bottleneck experiment, not a quality setting, and these are
# headless numbers -- the live editor's are the E1/E2 gate.
#   - unlit is NOT fibre-only: the tangent debug view skips the whole shading, marches and lookups too.
#   - novolume removes the coat march AND multiple scattering; nomarch removes the march alone.
#   - nofibre keeps every attenuation and replaces the BCSDF by a constant lobe.
#   - a child scope (Parent/Child) is INSIDE its parent: never add the two.
#   - CPU and GPU times are not additive; a frame takes the longer of what overlaps.
#   - castwhole casts the WHOLE coat into every shadow view (OLO_GROOM_SHADOW_CASTER_FRACTION=1): what the
#     caster share saves. posebake bakes the coat in each pose (OLO_DOG_POSEBAKE=1), a look override the
#     fixture reports as a failure; its numbers are still the run's.
#   - inplace walks on the spot (the dog put back at its start every frame); fixedcamera leaves the
#     runtime camera where it is instead of riding the dog: together, what the travelling walk costs.
#   - "noise" is the spread (max - min) of the three baselines: a difference smaller than it says nothing.

GPU frame p50 ms: run value (difference from the baseline mean)

# cacheMiB is the groom cache's budget aggregate, coat volumes INCLUDED; the memory table breaks it
# down. Logical bytes requested, not a driver VRAM reading; CPU rows are retained host arrays by
# allocated capacity, outside the cache budget.

# DogShowcaseEvidenceTest.CostOfTheThreeFramings (#1533 E4)
# GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090/PCIe/SSE2
# Release test binary, 1920x1080, GL Forward, the scene's TAA, the live scene's lawn, 240 runtime

# GPU ms are means of VALID GPUPassTimerPool samples; a sub-pass (Parent/Child) is INSIDE its parent.

# DogShowcaseEvidenceTest.CostOfTheThreeFramings (#1533 E4)
# GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090/PCIe/SSE2
# Release test binary, 1920x1080, GL Forward, the scene's TAA, the live scene's lawn, 240 runtime
# frames (animated and simulated) per framing after a 90-frame warm-up. Wall ms is per RunFrames(1).
# GPU ms are means of VALID GPUPassTimerPool samples; a sub-pass (Parent/Child) is INSIDE its parent.
# CPU ms per frame: solver (guide simulation), bake (coat-shadow volume), deform (strand build + upload).
# Headless: the live editor's p50/p95 are the E1/E2 gate; this file is the regression record.
# Build 0.0.1+a2fd7467ba, driver 4.6.0 NVIDIA 617.14.
# The editor's quality tier: 4096^2 cascades, PCF, AO technique 2, bloom on, FXAA on.
# Strands, segments and castShare are what the frame ACHIEVED (strides and caps apply), not what was asked.
# cacheMiB is the groom cache's budget aggregate, coat volumes INCLUDED; the memory table breaks it
# down. Logical bytes requested, not a driver VRAM reading; CPU rows are retained host arrays by
# allocated capacity, outside the cache budget.
# SUBSTITUTED (OLO_DOG_COST_SUB=strands25): a bottleneck experiment, not the shipped look.

# down. Logical bytes requested, not a driver VRAM reading; CPU rows are retained host arrays by
# allocated capacity, outside the cache budget.

# DogShowcaseEvidenceTest.CostOfTheThreeFramings (#1533 E4)
# GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090/PCIe/SSE2
# Release test binary, 1920x1080, GL Forward, the scene's TAA, the live scene's lawn, 240 runtime
# frames (animated and simulated) per framing after a 90-frame warm-up. Wall ms is per RunFrames(1).
# GPU ms are means of VALID GPUPassTimerPool samples; a sub-pass (Parent/Child) is INSIDE its parent.
# CPU ms per frame: solver (guide simulation), bake (coat-shadow volume), deform (strand build + upload).
# Headless: the live editor's p50/p95 are the E1/E2 gate; this file is the regression record.
# Build 0.0.1+a2fd7467ba, driver 4.6.0 NVIDIA 617.14.
# The editor's quality tier: 4096^2 cascades, PCF, AO technique 2, bloom on, FXAA on.
# Strands, segments and castShare are what the frame ACHIEVED (strides and caps apply), not what was asked.
# cacheMiB is the groom cache's budget aggregate, coat volumes INCLUDED; the memory table breaks it
# down. Logical bytes requested, not a driver VRAM reading; CPU rows are retained host arrays by
# allocated capacity, outside the cache budget.
# SUBSTITUTED (OLO_DOG_COST_SUB=noprepass): a bottleneck experiment, not the shipped look.

# GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090/PCIe/SSE2

# GPU ms are means of VALID GPUPassTimerPool samples; a sub-pass (Parent/Child) is INSIDE its parent.
# CPU ms per frame: solver (guide simulation), bake (coat-shadow volume), deform (strand build + upload).
# Headless: the live editor's p50/p95 are the E1/E2 gate; this file is the regression record.
# Build 0.0.1+a2fd7467ba, driver 4.6.0 NVIDIA 617.14.
# The editor's quality tier: 4096^2 cascades, PCF, AO technique 2, bloom on, FXAA on.
# Strands, segments and castShare are what the frame ACHIEVED (strides and caps apply), not what was asked.
# cacheMiB is the groom cache's budget aggregate, coat volumes INCLUDED; the memory table breaks it
# down. Logical bytes requested, not a driver VRAM reading; CPU rows are retained host arrays by
# allocated capacity, outside the cache budget.
# LAWN: OLO_DOG_COST_LAWN=0.

# DogShowcaseEvidenceTest.CostOfTheThreeFramings (#1533 E4)
# GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090/PCIe/SSE2
# Release test binary, 1920x1080, GL Forward, the scene's TAA, the live scene's lawn, 240 runtime
# frames (animated and simulated) per framing after a 90-frame warm-up. Wall ms is per RunFrames(1).
# GPU ms are means of VALID GPUPassTimerPool samples; a sub-pass (Parent/Child) is INSIDE its parent.
# CPU ms per frame: solver (guide simulation), bake (coat-shadow volume), deform (strand build + upload).
# Headless: the live editor's p50/p95 are the E1/E2 gate; this file is the regression record.
# Build 0.0.1+a2fd7467ba, driver 4.6.0 NVIDIA 617.14.
# The editor's quality tier: 4096^2 cascades, PCF, AO technique 2, bloom on, FXAA on.
# Strands, segments and castShare are what the frame ACHIEVED (strides and caps apply), not what was asked.
# cacheMiB is the groom cache's budget aggregate, coat volumes INCLUDED; the memory table breaks it
# down. Logical bytes requested, not a driver VRAM reading; CPU rows are retained host arrays by
# allocated capacity, outside the cache budget.

# down. Logical bytes requested, not a driver VRAM reading; CPU rows are retained host arrays by

# DogShowcaseEvidenceTest.CostOfTheThreeFramings (#1533 E4)
# GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090/PCIe/SSE2
# Release test binary, 1920x1080, GL Forward, the scene's TAA, the live scene's lawn, 240 runtime
# frames (animated and simulated) per framing after a 90-frame warm-up. Wall ms is per RunFrames(1).
# GPU ms are means of VALID GPUPassTimerPool samples; a sub-pass (Parent/Child) is INSIDE its parent.
# CPU ms per frame: solver (guide simulation), bake (coat-shadow volume), deform (strand build + upload).
